posts.meta_description:
62K likes, 969 comments - badboyshah on October 11, 2026: "I still remember the room where the Hustle team first approached me to be a judge. My first instinct was to say no. Too much had happened in the past, and I couldn’t ignore what my friends and the hip-hop community had been through.

But I listened. And I saw a new team that genuinely cared. Not just about a show, but about a platform that meant the world to so many young artists.

I agreed, but not without a few conditions. No unfair contracts. And prize money that could actually change someone’s life. I still remember the silence in that room when I mentioned the amount. 😂

Because talent needs more than applause. It needs opportunity. It needs resources. It needs someone to believe in it.

And then I met these kids. 

Strangers became familiar faces. Familiar faces became people I cared about. And somewhere along the way, they became family.

Their fears became my worries. Their little victories became my happiness. I wanted to protect them from everything I could, because I knew how much they were already carrying on their shoulders.

And before I knew it, we were at the finale.

Life is strange. Sometimes it opens a door you never intended to walk through. And on the other side, you find something so beautiful that you wonder what you would have missed had you never taken that chance.

Hustle was that door for me. And you guys were the beautiful view on the other side. ❤️

Go out and open as many doors as you can. Make memories and make bangers.

I came here to judge a competition. I leave having learned so much about love, courage, dreams and myself.

I don’t know if I’ll be in that big clumsy judge chair next year but I know I’ll carry a little bit of each one of you with me, wherever I go.

Your judge, brother, BADE BHAIYA or whatever you want to call me,

Badshah, signing off.

Love you guys. Always. ❤️".
